# Concurrency, locks and lanes: is this moment mine?

## What this region is

The template's coordination primitives, one per concern: cross-process mutual exclusion (Redis, row fencing), in-process ordering and bounded parallelism, newest-wins supersede lanes for jobs, non-overlapping recurring beats, and UI debouncing of backend calls.

## What it exists for

- Serialize writers across processes or jobs (one owner, one row, one dedupe key)
- Serialize or bound work inside one process
- Control which job runs when several compete (newest-wins vs priority)
- Own one resource and order writes to it
- Run background work with the right concurrency semantics
- Hold, watch or give up a supersede lane inside a job
- Run work repeatedly on a timer
- Debounce user input before it triggers work

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Which redis connection do I use → redis-caching-rate-limits
- Run this every night → cron
- Which job wrapper do I use → jobs-cron
- Keep slow jobs from blocking fast ones → job-lanes-outbox
- Make the page update when this changes → ws-channels
